Stock market news | Foodlink F&B Holdings sets price band for ₹361-crore IPO

Foodlink F&B Holdings has announced the price band for its ₹361-crore initial public offering at ₹181 to ₹191 per share. The issue opens for subscription on 26 November 2026.
